title: SunPath Solar Lease Collections Schedule: Grace, Late Fee and Default Figures
content:
For every SunPath Solar Lease system size, the collections figures are the same four numbers.

| Tier | Grace period after due date | Late fee | Days past due beyond which a default notice is sent | Notice period between default notice and termination |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 days | 30 calendar days |

**Grace period** — the number of calendar days after a bill's due date before the late fee applies: 10 for every size.

**Late fee** — the fee, in US dollars, when a monthly bill is unpaid after the grace period: $15.00 for every size.

**Default threshold** — the number of days past due after which a default notice is sent: 90 for every size.

**Default notice period** — the number of calendar days of notice between the default notice and termination: 30 for every size.

Because the four figures do not vary with system size, a lessee who holds leases of different sizes on different homes meets the same grace period, late fee, default threshold and notice period on each of them.
